content.text: need a short and catchy tag line for the Workroom app

Few short tagline options for Workroom:

- **"Spin up. Ship faster."**
- **"One project, many rooms."**
- **"Parallel work, zero clutter."**
- **"Workspaces on tap."**
- **"Branch out, without the mess."**

Fits best: git/jj worktree isolation + fast switching. Want more playful or more technical direction?
in a single short sentence, define what a Workroom actually is first
A Workroom is isolated copy of your project (Git worktree or JJ workspace) where you can code, test, or run agents without touching main.
